rule: Sell $20 of Nvidia on any drop at night, even a small one.

plan.summary: Sell up to $20 of NVDA for USDG when it drops 5% or more from the last US close while the market is closed, subject to the added safeguards; the requested “any drop” has no numeric threshold and is therefore not implemented literally.

checks.label: Market Is Closed
checks.why: This added check limits the sale to when the market is closed.

checks.label: Drop From Last Close
checks.why: No numeric trigger was stated, so this uses the 5% default.

checks.label: Limit Price Impact
checks.why: This added check applies a 1% price-impact threshold.

checks.label: Prevent Repeat Sale
checks.why: This added check prevents the rule from firing repeatedly.

checks.label: Cap Sale At $20
checks.why: This check caps the sale at the stated $20 amount.

assumptions: The missing numeric drop trigger defaults to 5%.
The 100% action setting does not convert the $20 amount; the $20 size cap limits the sale.
unclear: “Any drop” does not specify a numeric threshold, so the rule uses the 5% default rather than literally triggering on every decline.
Nighttime is not supported as a time-based condition; market closure is used instead.
